{"content": """"Apply this pass's sidecar repairs to the memory tree, in canonical JSON formatting.

Writes only the two sidecars whose references cite paths the paired code tree does not hold:

* grepai/setup.py.json  references.2 -- an `unresolved` target naming a card that does not
  exist becomes the code that owns the claim (the lifecycle facade and `grepai_docker_mode`);
* grepai/isolated.py.json references.3 -- the two identity-helper anchors name
  `kernel/primitives/identity.py`, absent from the paired tree, and become the call sites
  inside isolated.py that use those helpers;
* grepai/isolated.py.json references.4 -- the three dashboard topology anchors name
  `dashboard/src/topology/model.ts`, absent from the paired tree, and are dropped; the two
  in-file anchors that remain carry the claim.

Anchors are computed, never typed: each is resolved at the paired code tree C with the shipped
writer's own CodeSnapshot, so `blob` is the tree entry's blob and `content` the sha256 of the
exact bytes the locator names.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from agents_remember.application.knowledge_writer.code_anchors import CodeSnapshot
from agents_remember.models.knowledge_files.canonical import canonical_text

TRIAL = Path(
    "/var/tmp/mik-run3/architect/eval-sandbox/20261030-old-text-hermes/"
    "hermes-CE02/trials/80281145-912e-4e4a-b3cb-b2892ad7eb48"
)
CODE = TRIAL / "project/projects/code"
MEMORY = TRIAL / "project/coordination/memory-repos/ar-code"
ONBOARDING = MEMORY / "onboarding/mcp/src/agents_remember/providers"

GREPAI_SETUP_JSON = ONBOARDING / "grepai/setup.py.json"
GREPAI_ISOLATED_JSON = ONBOARDING / "grepai/isolated.py.json"

LIFECYCLE_CORE = "mcp/src/agents_remember/providers/grepai/lifecycle/core.py"
LIFECYCLE_FACADE = "mcp/src/agents_remember/providers/grepai/lifecycle/__init__.py"
OWN_SOURCE = "mcp/src/agents_remember/providers/grepai/isolated.py"


def target(snapshot: CodeSnapshot, path: str, locator: dict[str, Any], owner: str) -> dict:
    """One `code` target, its anchor resolved at C (path recorded only when it is another file)."""
    anchor = snapshot.resolve(path, locator)
    document: dict[str, Any] = {
        "blob": anchor.blob,
        "content": anchor.content,
        "locator": locator,
    }
    if path != owner:
        document["path"] = path
    return {"anchor": document, "kind": "code"}


def main() -> None:
    snapshot = CodeSnapshot.capture(CODE)
    print(f"code tree C = {snapshot.tree}")

    setup = json.loads(GREPAI_SETUP_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    owner = setup["path"]
    setup["references"]["2"] = {
        "note": (
            "Docker-owned GrepAI lifecycle behavior lives in the GrepAI lifecycle modules.\n\n"
            "Anchor: `grepai_docker_mode`, `agents_remember.providers.grepai.lifecycle`"
        ),
        "targets": [
            target(snapshot, LIFECYCLE_CORE, {"kind": "symbol", "name": "grepai_docker_mode"}, owner),
            target(snapshot, LIFECYCLE_FACADE, {"kind": "file"}, owner),
        ],
    }

    isolated = json.loads(GREPAI_ISOLATED_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    isolated["references"]["3"] = {
        "note": (
            "The worktree instance id and the ownership labels this file writes are derived by the "
            "shared identity helpers at these call sites; the file derives no identity of its own.\n\n"
            "Anchor: `isolated_grepai_settings`, `_isolated_grepai_base_fields`"
        ),
        "targets": [
            target(
                snapshot,
                OWN_SOURCE,
                {"kind": "symbol", "name": "isolated_grepai_settings"},
                owner,
            ),
            target(
                snapshot,
                OWN_SOURCE,
                {"kind": "symbol", "name": "_isolated_grepai_base_fields"},
                owner,
            ),
        ],
    }
    isolated["references"]["4"] = {
        "note": (
            "Aggregate GrepAI settings and project roots remain internal data: the payload carries "
            "the one `grepai-memory` provider block under the discovery-only/source-proof policy, "
            "and the roots list is rewritten in place. The settings add no topology node of their own.\n\n"
            "Anchor: `_isolated_settings_payload`, `_isolated_grepai_roots`"
        ),
        "targets": [
            target(
                snapshot,
                OWN_SOURCE,
                {"kind": "symbol", "name": "_isolated_settings_payload"},
                owner,
            ),
            target(
                snapshot,
                OWN_SOURCE,
                {"kind": "symbol", "name": "_isolated_grepai_roots"},
                owner,
            ),
        ],
    }

    for path, document in ((GREPAI_SETUP_JSON, setup), (GREPAI_ISOLATED_JSON, isolated)):
        text = canonical_text(document)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"wrote {path.relative_to(MEMORY)} ({len(text)} bytes)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
